title: Kimi sela
style: Punk-rock, palm-muted power chords, brisk straight-ahead drive, fuzzy guitar bleed, gritty female vocals in a high, light upper register with call-and-response backing voices.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Lora kemi suta pano
Vela muri tano keli
Sora lemi vuta rano
Pela nuri mano seli

[Verse 2]
Kira temu lona sari
Nema koli vura tani
Mira lemu pona kari
Sema noli mura pani

[Pre-Chorus]
Talo rena kumi sela
Veno mura toli kena
Palo lena sumi vela
Keno nura moli tena

[Chorus]
Sora keli muna taro
Lena vuri pano seli
Mora neli luna karo
Pena muri tano veli

[Verse 3]
Rima kelo suna pari
Tema noli vura kani
Lima selo muna tari
Nema koli pura sani

[Pre-Chorus]
Talo rena kumi sela
Veno mura toli kena
Palo lena sumi vela
Keno nura moli tena

[Chorus]
Sora keli muna taro
Lena vuri pano seli
Mora neli luna karo
Pena muri tano veli

[Bridge]
Kelo sari muna tero
Neli vora pana seli
Melo kari luna nero
Peli nora tana veli

[Breakdown]
Sa-ri-ke-lo-mu-na-te
Ve-li-no-ra-pa-na-se
Ma-ri-se-lo-lu-na-ne
Pe-li-ko-ra-ta-na-ve

[Final Chorus]
Sora keli muna taro
Lena vuri pano seli
Mora neli luna karo
Pena muri tano veli

Mora neli luna karo
Pena muri tano veli
